prompts: Create an original Instagram recruitment poster for a forestry newsletter. Landscape 3:2 1536x1024. Collectible Golden Age American painted illustration inspired by N.C. Wyeth and Philip R. Goodwin, visibly hand painted, confident composition. Integrate beautifully legible exact typography with generous margins: 'The Woods Run Digest' (large title); 'Forestry & Wood Products news'; 'Subscribe free • Link in bio'. No other text, logos, QR codes or watermarks. Scene: close, warm amber cooperage workshop, craftsperson fitting curved oak staves to a barrel on a low bench, oak shavings and hand tools, quiet daylight across textured wood, indigo apron, no suspenders. Fresh composition unlike a sawmill, strong diagonal barrel, title in calm upper area, cream footer.
